events.description: Northern Afghanistan deployment: CIA items include maintaining momentum with Masoud, capture options for UBL and his lieutenants, and continuing dialogue with Masoud. The text is heavily redacted and garbled.

Planned or ongoing Northern Afghanistan deployment, with action items to maintain momentum with Masoud, continue dialogue with him, and develop capture options for UBL and his lieutenant. The text is heavily garbled and redacted.

relationships.detail: The update lists continuing dialogue with Masoud and maintaining momentum with him on UBL capture options.
The slide lists maintaining momentum with Masoud (garbled OCR) in connection with options against UBL and his lieutenant. This is inferred to be cooperation against bin Ladin.

relationships.detail: The slide lists 'capture options' for UBL and his lieutenant as a planning item. No capture is reported. The slide does not name the CIA as the actor, so the attribution is inferred from the document's source.
Masoud is linked to the Northern Afghanistan deployment slide. This is inferred from context and not stated explicitly.

key_claims: The CIA planned to maintain momentum with Masoud on options to capture Usama bin Ladin and his lieutenants.
A northern Afghanistan deployment was part of the CIA's effort against the Islamic extremist terrorist threat.
The CIA intended to continue its dialogue with Masoud.
The document is heavily redacted, so details of the deployment and capture options are unavailable.
